facts.fact: WorldPop says it trained Somalia National Bureau of Statistics and UNFPA staff in an 8-day workshop in Nairobi to delineate pre-census enumeration areas in five districts (Dhusamareeb, Baidoa, Kaxda, Belet Weyne, Kismayo) for the upcoming national census, with full enumeration of those districts to follow if security permits; the last successful census was 50 years ago.
